title: 20万新增就业：可能只是，数据幻觉？
speaker: Anna Wong

segments.en: Yeah. So downward persistent downward revisions to jobs data has been the trend for the last three years, really.
segments.zh: 是的，就业数据的持续下修在过去三年里已成为趋势。

segments.en: And whenever the direction of revisions is primarily toward one direction, in this case, that work, it suggests that there is something more structural going on that the first cut of the data is not able to show.
segments.zh: 每当修正方向主要偏向一个方向时，这表明存在更结构性的问题，而初步数据无法显示。

segments.en: And usually what that means is that the labor market is not strong as one thought.
segments.zh: 这通常意味着劳动力市场并不像人们想象的那么强劲。

segments.en: So this means that whenever you see a blowout, jobs front going forward, like over 200K, I think we all have to take it with a grain of salt.
segments.zh: 这意味着，今后如果看到超过20万的强劲就业数据，我们都应该持保留态度。

segments.en: Now as to the precise cause of these downward revisions, well, it is from the birth and death model, and also from the lower response rate in the first survey of the month.
segments.zh: 至于下修的具体原因，来自出生-死亡模型，以及月度首次调查的较低回复率。

segments.en: Earlier this year, the BLS announced a, I'm a theological change in the birth and death model.
segments.zh: 今年早些时候，劳工统计局宣布对出生-死亡模型进行方法上的改变。

segments.en: That is, supposedly will be better able to capture these real time, increase in hiring and decrease in hiring from jobs going out of business or new businesses forming.
segments.zh: 这将更好地捕捉企业倒闭或新企业成立带来的实时就业增减。

segments.en: And it's not because any federal agencies, the petition is fudging the numbers.
segments.zh: 这并不是因为任何联邦机构在篡改数据。
